name: Submitting To Your Husband
overview: Scripture teaches that wives are called to submit to their own husbands as to the Lord, reflecting a God-ordained order established since the fall, where the husband is given a role of leadership (Genesis 3:16; Ephesians 5:22; Colossians 3:18). This submission is not a call to inferiority but is set within the context of mutual respect and reverence for God, as all believers are urged to submit to one another out of reverence for Him (Ephesians 5:21). Husbands, in turn, are commanded to love their wives sacrificially, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself for her, highlighting the self-giving love that undergirds the marital relationship (Ephesians 5:25).
